hooks.command: for p in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$p" in dist/*|*/dist/*|package-lock.json|*/package-lock.json|coverage/*|*/coverage/*|*/.reppo/cli-state.json) echo "Blocked: $p is a generated/state file. Run the build/install instead of editing it directly." >&2; exit 2;; esac; done
for p in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$p" in src/*.ts) npx eslint --fix "$p" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; done
